content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text evaluates a collision in which the challenger's own cited verses are treated as a footed chain against Matthew 1:20.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed (1 Chronicles 28:6, Acts 1:8) but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb; answered in [CR3] LINK 2.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"The phrase 'chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse': reading one, the judge may identify the targeted verse's own wording as part of its footing but must still weigh the whole chains by footing; reading two, using the targeted sentence's own wording to resolve the collision is the forbidden verse-by-verse method.","why":"The judge acknowledges the challenger's chain is footed yet treats Matthew 1:20's own wording as the reason the result is underdetermined, rather than comparing the chains by footing."}
